flows:
Navigate to http://localhost:3001/app then Verify Available quota reads "$4,500.00".
Click "+ Top Up Quota ($250)" with a mouse click, as a user would.
Do not use the keyboard, and do not wait for or work around anything that covers it; if the click does not reach it, the check fails.
Verify Available quota reads "$4,750.00" and Action status displays "QUOTA_TOPUP_SUCCESS".

remark: wait: Waiting cannot click "+ Top Up Quota ($250)" because it is covered

summary:
The displayed maintenance notice is in the bottom-right corner and does not overlap the visible "+ Top Up Quota ($250)" control. The agent completed the initial quota check but then did not perform the required mouse click or the follow-up checks.
Update the run logic to verify actual screen overlap at the click point before declaring an element covered, then retry the mouse click when the control is visibly clear.
one_liner: The run stopped before attempting the top-up because it incorrectly treated the button as covered.
reason: The requested top-up button is covered, and the constraints prohibit waiting for or working around the obstruction.
